scope: Reviewer-requested post-hoc diagnostics on newly replayed fixed live trajectories. This lock does not modify or replace the frozen workshop run, its prespecification, units, confidence intervals, or verdict.

packet_strength_definitions.loss_convention: half mean squared loss for the theoretical decomposition; actuator gradients are the equivalent PyTorch mean-squared-loss gradients and therefore twice as large
packet_strength_definitions.S_J: sum_i ||J_i - mean(J)||_2^2 (a sum, not a mean)
packet_strength_definitions.S_y: sum_i (y_i - mean(y))^2 (a sum, not a mean)
packet_strength_definitions.covariance_to_true_gradient: ||Cov(J,y)|| divided by the norm of the raw half-squared-loss gradient
packet_strength_definitions.empirical_permutation_moment: mean squared L2 distance of the 16 realized half-gradients from the exact permutation expectation

actuators.normalized_equal_radius: theta minus multiplier*median_recent_live_update_norm*g/||g||; true, exact expected-permutation, and every permutation direction are normalized separately
actuators.raw_calibrated: theta minus multiplier*eta*g with one eta=median_recent_live_update_norm/||true_previous_gradient|| shared by true, expected, and permuted directions
actuators.replay_sgd: from the current center, perform 1, 2, or 4 virtual SGD steps on the immediately preceding packet; eta is calibrated once so the first true replay step has the median recent live-update norm, and is then held fixed for all replicas and steps
actuators.trajectory: all actuator states are discarded; the live learner receives exactly one ordinary update on each current packet

locality_diagnostics.activation_crossing: for observed current-packet inputs, record whether a ReLU preactivation reaches or crosses zero on each one-step center-to-endpoint segment; for multi-step replay this is explicitly only the straight center-to-final-endpoint chord, not every segment of its curved optimization path
locality_diagnostics.taylor_remainder: on the radius grid, compare the observed current-packet MSE change with the directional first-order term and report the finite-grid remainder and curvature quotient
locality_diagnostics.claim_limit: these are empirical finite-grid diagnostics and do not verify global differentiability or prove a uniform Lipschitz-gradient condition

inference.primary_estimand_for_block_sensitivity: normalized equal-radius true-versus-permutation pairing increment at radius multiplier 1

execution.failure_policy: any missing, non-finite, source-mismatched, state-mutating, decomposition-inconsistent, or incomplete unit fails the campaign

interpretation_limits: This campaign is post-hoc and cannot retrospectively strengthen the original prespecification.
Repeated permutations integrate conditional Monte Carlo variability only for the locked within-packet permutation distribution.
Packet-strength metrics quantify whether the permutation intervention had raw-gradient variation; they do not by themselves establish prospective task value.
Finite observed-input ReLU crossing and Taylor diagnostics do not prove differentiability or uniform smoothness.
The multi-step replay actuator deliberately stores one previous packet and is a sensitivity analysis, not the original no-replay method.
Breadth beyond scalar squared-loss regression is handled by a separate campaign and must not be inferred from this one.
